emojis.title: Lula Wins Re-election as Bolsonaro Rejects Result
emojis.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s win ended a string of conservative victories in Latin America. His opponent, Flávio Bolsonaro, called for the election to be annulled.

emojis.summary: He will be observed to evaluate whether his "psychiatric health is compatible with pursuing his interrogation", authorities said.

emojis.summary: The Houthis, an Iran-backed Yemeni militia, launched several deadly attacks on the airport this month.
